entries.text: Raw physical strength. A high Strength is good for physical characters. Modifies: Hit Points, Melee Damage, and Carry Weight.
entries.source_text: Raw physical strength. A high Strength is good for physical characters. Modifies: Hit Points, Melee Damage, and Carry Weight.

entries.text: 身体的力量。力量越高杀伤力就越强。影响项目：生命力、武器伤害力、以及最高负荷重量。
entries.source_text: 身体的力量。力量越高杀伤力就越强。影响项目：生命力、武器伤害力、以及最高负荷重量。

entries.text: The ability to see, hear, taste and notice unusual things. A high Perception is important for a sharpshooter.  Modifies: Sequence and ranged combat distance modifiers.
entries.source_text: The ability to see, hear, taste and notice unusual things. A high Perception is important for a sharpshooter.  Modifies: Sequence and ranged combat distance modifiers.

entries.text: 视觉、听觉、味觉、以及能够发现不寻常情况的能力。高度的敏感度对于狙击手相当的有帮助。影响项目：战斗顺序以及远距离的战斗。
entries.source_text: 视觉、听觉、味觉、以及能够发现不寻常情况的能力。高度的敏感度对于狙击手相当的有帮助。影响项目：战斗顺序以及远距离的战斗。

entries.text: Stamina and physical toughness. A character with a high Endurance will survive where others may not. Modifies: Hit Points, Poison & Radiation Resistance, Healing Rate, and the additional hit points per level.
entries.source_text: Stamina and physical toughness. A character with a high Endurance will survive where others may not. Modifies: Hit Points, Poison & Radiation Resistance, Healing Rate, and the additional hit points per level.

entries.text: 忍耐力以及体能上的忍受能力。拥有高度体力的人将可以在战斗中存活的较久。影响项目：生命力、毒以及放射线的防御能力、恢复速度、以及升级时所增加的生命值。
entries.source_text: 忍耐力以及体能上的忍受能力。拥有高度体力的人将可以在战斗中存活的较久。影响项目：生命力、毒以及放射线的防御能力、恢复速度、以及升级时所增加的生命值。

entries.text: A combination of appearance and charm. A high Charisma is important for characters that want to influence people with words. Modifies: NPC reactions, and barter prices.
entries.source_text: A combination of appearance and charm. A high Charisma is important for characters that want to influence people with words. Modifies: NPC reactions, and barter prices.

entries.text: 外表吸引他人的能力。拥有高度的魅力比较能够轻易的说服他人。影响项目：非玩家人物的反应、以及杀价的能力。
entries.source_text: 外表吸引他人的能力。拥有高度的魅力比较能够轻易的说服他人。影响项目：非玩家人物的反应、以及杀价的能力。

entries.text: Knowledge, wisdom and the ability to think quickly. A high Intelligence is important for any character. Modifies: the number of new skill points per level, dialogue options, and many skills.
entries.source_text: Knowledge, wisdom and the ability to think quickly. A high Intelligence is important for any character. Modifies: the number of new skill points per level, dialogue options, and many skills.

entries.text: 知识、智慧、以及反应力。无论是怎的角色，智力都是相当重要的一个项目。影响项目：每一个等级所得到的新技巧、更多的谈话选项、以及许多的技术。
entries.source_text: 知识、智慧、以及反应力。无论是怎的角色，智力都是相当重要的一个项目。影响项目：每一个等级所得到的新技巧、更多的谈话选项、以及许多的技术。

entries.text: Coordination and the ability to move well. A high Agility is important for any active character. Modifies: Action Points, Armor Class, Sequence, and many skills.
entries.source_text: Coordination and the ability to move well. A high Agility is important for any active character. Modifies: Action Points, Armor Class, Sequence, and many skills.

entries.text: 是否能够灵活移动的能力。在战斗上，拥有高度的灵活度尤其重要。影响项目：动作值、防御能力、战斗顺序、以及许多其它的技术。
entries.source_text: 是否能够灵活移动的能力。在战斗上，拥有高度的灵活度尤其重要。影响项目：动作值、防御能力、战斗顺序、以及许多其它的技术。

entries.text: Fate. Karma. An extremely high or low Luck will affect the character - somehow. Events and situations will be changed by how lucky (or unlucky) your character is.

entries.text: 命运、灵力等。运气与一切的行动都有密不可分的关系。许多在游戏中的事件都会因玩家的运气值而有所不同。
